videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.title: One-Stop Abrasive Belt Manufacturer — Factory Tour & Full Production Line
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.body: A two-and-a-half-minute walk through our abrasive belt plant in Xianning, Hubei. The camera follows one belt from raw material to a sealed carton: jumbo rolls of abrasive cloth arriving and being checked, the roll moving onto the converting line, grain and backing confirmed against the order, then slitting, joint making and hot pressing. Later shots cover measurement and quality checking at the end of the line, finished endless belts stacked for dispatch, and the warehouse holding standard sizes for immediate shipment. For buyers comparing suppliers, the useful part is the middle: converting is done in-house, so the spec you confirm in the quotation is the spec that comes off the line.

videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.body: Our location in one paragraph: Tongcheng County, Hubei — the abrasive cloth town of China and the central production base for ultra-wide belts. Founded in 2021, the plant cuts the master roll, slits to width, hot presses and cures, then checks, packs and ships. This video explains what ultra-wide means for your application: single-piece belts above 1500 mm without a joint to fail, which is what wide-belt grinding and calibration lines need.

The clip shows the construction we supply — aluminum oxide cloth flaps over a backing plate — and the handling points that decide disc life: a flap disc matched to the tool's rated speed, with the guard fitted and the disc presented flat rather than pressed on its edge. For bulk buyers, the practical note is that flap quality and adhesive cure are visible in this footage.

videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.a2: They can be rinsed and reused until the abrasive layer is spent; lifetime depends on grit, pressure and the surface worked.
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.title: How to Remove Wall Scratches Easily with a Sanding Sponge Block
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.body: A two-minute repair filmed in one shot: find the scratch on the painted wall, work the sponge block over it gently, then touch up. The point for buyers is the grit choice — fine grade only, light pressure, and you are blending a mark rather than removing a coating. An abrasive sponge block is the correct tool here; a hard disc will cut through the paint around the scratch.

videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.a1: Fine grade only. A hard disc or coarse grit cuts through the paint surrounding the scratch and enlarges the repair.

videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.title: Multi-Purpose Hook and Loop Sanding Discs — Wood, Metal, Wall & Fine Finishing
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.body: One hook-and-loop disc across four jobs: polishing an epoxy river table, stripping rust and old paint from metal, prepping drywall and putty, and fine detail work on small parts and jewellery. The through-line is dust extraction — the perforated pattern is there to keep the surface clean so you can see when the scratch is gone, which is the actual reason to choose a dustless disc over a solid one.

videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.q1: Hook-and-loop or PSA for my tool?
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.a1: Hook-and-loop suits frequent grit changes on a random-orbit sander; PSA suits flat pads and long run times. Mesh discs suit dust extraction.
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.a2: Not required, but a dustless or mesh disc keeps the surface visible so you stop when the scratch is gone instead of sanding on.

videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.title: Flap Disc in Action: Grinding Heavy Steel Plate on a Real Job Site
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.body: Field footage, no studio: an operator taking down weld and mill scale along the edge of a heavy steel plate with a flap disc. It shows the working angle, the pressure, and how fast the disc loads on mill scale — which is the difference between a disc that lasts a shift and one that glazes. Real conditions, which is more useful for specifying grit than a catalogue photo.

videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.q1: Why does my disc glaze on mill scale?
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.a1: Mill scale loads the abrasive quickly. Choose a coarser grit, keep the disc flat to the work and dress the surface as it loads.
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.a2: Coarse grit removes stock and scale efficiently; move to a finer grit for blending the edge afterwards.

videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.body: 一支片子讲清百叶轮的用法与做法：焊缝打磨、木材去毛刺的实拍开场，接背胶、砂布裁切叠层、热压固化全流程，最后看成品是否耐磨、不掉片。对采购方来说，片中叠层与热压两段就是百叶轮寿命的来源，也可作为选择粒度与背板时的参照。
